accepted_new_failures.reason: Pre-existing contradiction between two PROTECTED artifacts, made visible (not caused) by plan 31-C2 removing Event_Dispatcher.py's unconditional 'import pigpio'. That import was a COLLECTION ERROR, so conftest.py's collect_ignore had kept this whole module dark since Phase 25; the module now collects and 9 of its 10 tests pass. The failing one asserts event_data['value'] == 'baseline' for a non-numeric Tracker.set, which was the Phase 25 contract. Phase 26 CMP-16 then deliberately changed it: log_value.coerce_for_event diverts non-numbers to value_str and leaves value None, because event.event_data.value is mapped 'long' in event_log_v2 and a bare non-numeric string makes Elasticsearch reject the WHOLE document (proven live, run 549). The test and log_value.py are both protected and cannot both be right; resolving it means editing a protected file, which is a Rule 4 architectural decision for the user, not this plan's to take. Logged in deferred-items.md. No C2 code is implicated: logging_utils' Mics_Tracker branch is byte-identical.

superseded.note: Captured AFTER the Phase 31 Plan 01 dev-host dependency fix (requirements-dev.txt: msgpack, npyscreen, numpy, pytz, tzlocal, requests, blosc, tables, pandas, tornado, scipy, pyzmq) and BEFORE any code change. Pre-fix, with the system interpreter (no requirements-dev.txt installed), the tree measured 179 failed / 203 passed over 381 collected, with the sole reported ModuleNotFoundError being npyscreen. Fixing npyscreen and tzlocal (autopilot/autopilot/utils/common.py:18) does NOT reduce the failure count: the same 179 node ids fail for a DIFFERENT, deeper reason found empirically during this plan - autopilot/networking/Event_Dispatcher.py:3 does an unconditional `import pigpio`, and pigpio is deliberately excluded from requirements-dev.txt per this plan's own instruction (the recording fake at tests/fakes/fake_pigpio.py, Task 3, is what the clean-room clock layer in plans C1/C2 develops against - installing the real client would let a test pass against something the rig does not run). So the post-fix count is 179 failed / 208 passed over 387 collected - 208 vs 203 is 5 MORE passing tests, entirely accounted for by this plan's own tests/test_pytest_delta.py (5 cases, all green); the 179 pre-existing failures are unchanged in identity and count. This baseline freezes that pigpio-blocked set; resolving it is explicitly out of Plan 01's scope (see 31-01-PLAN.md objective) and is not expected until a later Phase 31 plan replaces Event_Dispatcher's clock handling.
